clock_contract: Reuse frozen records() for physical packet sequence and cumulative maximum archive milliseconds. Admit whole packets only when available_ms*1000000 < exact original issued_at_ns - lag_seconds*1000000000. Regressed packets retain their true original stamp and cumulative availability; their field observations are marked ambiguous until a later nonregressed update. All Lines in one packet apply atomically before any query snapshot.
forbidden: external label or target table reads
physical nearest-car or lapped-traffic proximity claim
limits: Race-order time gap is distinct from physical nearest-car distance; lap-deficit categories do not locate lapped traffic.
Archive clocks and canonical original issuance timestamps are retrospective availability proxies, not certified historical client receipt.
Existing seasons and earlier scores are exposed; no pristine holdout or predictive gain is claimed.
No parser-derived ahead-driver identity is certified from asynchronously updated ranks.
outputs: Per-event/per-lag original-issuance snapshots with explicit field categories, parsed values, source sequences/clocks, ages and readiness flags
Full-stream update counts by field, outer/leaf raw type, category and clear status
Per-event/per-lag readiness, staleness, rank inconsistency and missingness counts
Immutable source/input/run closures and failure receipts
parser_lookahead_limit: The reused generic iterator may decode one pending packet to obtain its timestamp. No pending payload, parsing counters or field values enter an earlier snapshot. Invariance tests cover timestamp-valid future appends. An invalid timestamp has no certified temporal placement and marks source uncertainty when reached; no unknown-clock future-invariance claim is made.
rank_change: A changed observed rank records its packet sequence. An interval from an earlier sequence is flagged until explicitly updated. Same-packet rank and gap changes are atomic and order invariant. Duplicate current reported ranks are flagged; these snapshots do not identify an ahead driver.

raw_semantics.absent: No update; retain prior observation with its original timestamp and sequence.
raw_semantics.clear: Explicit null or blank string replaces the previous observation; unavailable markers -, --, N/A, NONE, NULL do likewise.
raw_semantics.lap_deficit: Optional leading plus followed by positive integer LAP or LAPS is a categorical lap deficit, never converted into seconds.
raw_semantics.leader: LEADER is an explicit leader marker. LAP n is a separate leader-lap-counter marker, not a numeric interval.
raw_semantics.numeric: Finite nonnegative scalar/string seconds, optional leading plus and whitespace; colon durations with bounded trailing components allowed. Booleans and negative/nonfinite values are invalid.
raw_semantics.object: Only an explicitly present Value updates a field. An object lacking Value is metadata-only, not a clear or freshness refresh.
raw_semantics.other: Unrecognized strings/types are invalid and counted.
raw_semantics.position: Only an integer rank from 1 through 20 is valid; explicit clears invalidate current rank.

readiness.leader_gap: Separately report fresh numeric/leader/lap-deficit GapToLeader categories.
readiness.policy: Per-row flags only: all rows retained, no empirical coverage threshold or performance advancement decision in this pilot.
readiness.rank_1: Explicit leader/leader-lap-counter or numeric zero GapToLeader, freshly updated; an absent/cleared interval alone does not invalidate a consistently identified leader.
readiness.rank_2_to_20: Fresh numeric interval, known unique current rank, interval updated at or after the last rank change, and no current leader/category inconsistency or source ambiguity.
